provenance.tool: tests/reference/derive_eve.py (Python 3.13 standard library: csv, fractions, decimal); hand computation
provenance.steps: Hand-built monthly projections (cash_flows.csv, every month from 1 to the end). BASE, PAR_UP, PAR_DOWN and CONTRACT of MTG_FIX EUR run 15 months; month 15 is a final repayment with opening = scheduled, so it has no SMM and is left out of n (n = 14 over the projection, 12 over the first 12 months, which include a month with exposure and SMM 0). BASE CON_FIX EUR runs 12 months with the zero-exposure final month 12, so n = 11 in both windows. BASE MTG_RST EUR reprices 510 at its reset in month 6 and BASE MTG_FLT EUR 396 at its reset in month 3; their repricing principal enters the repricing time. BASE SME_FIX EUR has only a zero-exposure month: no projected CPR. Repricing time sum (k/12) x principal / sum principal, monthly SMM prepaid / (opening - scheduled) and their products exact in rationals; 1 - (prod (1 - SMM))^(12/n) exact for integral 12/n, otherwise in decimal at 60 significant digits. Effective duration of MTG_FIX EUR: PVs on the curves of curves.csv as in EVE-PV-01; PAR_UP and PAR_DOWN are BASE (-0.3% at 1 year, 2% at 5 years) shifted by 200 bp, the nominal EUR parallel shock of REG-3 Annex Part A, and floored (REG-3 Art. 3(7)): at 1 year the floor min(-0.3%, -1.5% + 0.03%) = -1.47% binds on PAR_DOWN (-2.3%), so dr stays the nominal 0.02; (PV_PAR_DOWN - PV_PAR_UP) / (2 x PV_BASE x 0.02). Rounded to 40 significant digits. The effective_duration_hand points are hand computations: (1,030 - 990) / (2 x 1,000 x 0.02) = 1, and no value when PV_BASE is 0 or negative.
